conferenceDecisions.question: How much existing liquid water freezes, for how long, and what finite actual support/collision/break/melt/occupancy behavior does that same water gain?
conferenceDecisions.proposal:
KEEP Action, point range 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous 10d6 cold in a 60-foot radius and freezing actual water. NEW choose a perceived point with caster line of effect; form a true 60-foot-radius sphere around it. Range limits the chosen center, not the far edge. Snapshot every creature in the sphere with center line of effect, including allies and the caster when their bodies qualify. Each makes CON for full shared 10d6 on failure or half, rounded down, on success. This damage profile does not independently damage all equipment or structures. Cold immunity/prevention governs creature damage, not whether nearby independent water freezes. No Core Frozen, Paralysis or recurring cold tick is supplied.

NEW the environmental part freezes existing ordinary exposed liquid water in the sphere to a maximum of one vertical foot below each actual open surface. Only original water volumes inside the sphere with an unobstructed exposure path to that surface qualify; this is not a scan through a sealed roof, riverbed, ice cap or other solid barrier. A small open puddle or offered container freezes its actual lesser quantity. Moving water contributes only the finite volume physically present in that snapshot; later flow does not continually freeze. Bodily fluids, living tissue, water incorporated in food/other mixtures, sealed vessels, and hostile worn/carried containers are excluded. An actual caster-held or deliberately offered open vessel may qualify. Salt and contaminants remain with the same batch; magical freezing does not purify them or convert another liquid into water. Actual temporary conjured water retains its original source lifetime, no-sale rule and hydration-use history through freezing and melting.

NEW spell-specific engine geometry treats this phase change as conserving the selected water's occupied volume and actual mass; it causes no pressure-expansion damage. Record the original liquid volume/weight and resulting ice lot without inventing a standard conversion density or extra water. This is an explicit simplified magical phase rule, not a claim about scientific expansion. Body and independent-object volumes are excluded, along with a shortest open clearance route through the selected water to its preexisting open surface. Freezing therefore creates real ice but does not encase, crush, suffocate or automatically restrain an immersed creature. The excluded clearance does not tunnel through unchanged solid matter. Ice remains in its real position or floats on its actual supporting water; it cannot levitate over an empty gap or move an unwilling body to create room.

NEW default handling profile for a continuous five-foot-by-five-foot ice section at least six inches thick: AC 12, 20 structural HP, ordinary susceptibility to weapon damage, immunity to poison/psychic damage, vulnerability to fire damage, and a maximum supported load of 500 lb on that local section while it is genuinely supported by ground or afloat in sufficient water. Thinner ice has no guaranteed creature-support permission; actual smaller handled pieces retain proportional structural HP/mass and their real shape. Adjacent sections keep real shared material identity; dividing a sheet creates no extra total HP or maximum load for the same occupied footprint. Exceeding the default load breaks that section and loses its support, rather than producing a crush attack. An actual independently established stronger/weaker ice hazard profile supersedes this fallback. Structural breaks produce the same real ice pieces and ordinary water/fall exposure, not another spell damage packet. Supported ice is difficult terrain; a creature makes one DEX save against the original spell DC on its first voluntary entry or regular START there in its regular-turn cycle, not both, falling Prone on failure. This slip profile remains a mundane surface hazard until the physical ice changes; it is not a continuing dispellable spell.

NEW absent an actual scenario heat profile, each formed lot completely thaws after one cumulative elapsed hour exposed to above-freezing conditions. Time in actual freezing conditions pauses that thaw-exposure clock, without providing permanent preservation of other stock. Splits retain elapsed exposure and proportional remaining material; an insulated container needs an actual applicable insulation rule, not a name. For a positive-HP section, fire melts the fraction min(1, actual structural HP lost to this fire / structural HP immediately before this fire) of its current intact ice mass into the same water; other damage merely breaks it into its real remaining pieces. A section reaching zero from fire therefore melts its remaining intact mass, not extra overkill mass. Already broken loose pieces need their actual smaller handling profile before further damage; no fresh undamaged stock appears. Avoid counting the same destroyed fraction as both retained ice and liquid. Real environmental heat may thaw it sooner under its declared profile. Dispel or antimagic after the completed instantaneous change does not undo real ice. Later harvesting, transport, melting, use or sale operates on the one actual water/ice lot, with contaminants and custody unchanged. No pure-water yield, extra Supply, rare ingredient, cold-storage entitlement for unrelated food, stored orb or delayed detonation is created.

conferenceDecisions.question: Agree the restored after-completed-hostile-use trigger, INT save, point-centered20ft area and earliest finite next-elected-Reaction debt (including an actually chosen special Reaction)?
conferenceDecisions.proposal: KEEP Reaction, casting-point range20feet, V/S/F,20-foot radius and4d6psychic plus loss of next Reaction. NEW actual trigger: immediately after a creature the caster currently perceives and regards as hostile within20feet completes an Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. The triggering use must have fully resolved; one event supplies one opportunity and the caster must have a legal unused Reaction and casting permissions. A movement segment, ordinary object interaction or the caster's own opportunity is not a trigger. This spell does not interrupt or refund the triggering action/reaction. Choose a perceived center within20feet with line of effect at commitment; snapshot all currently perceived designated hostile creatures inside its20-foot-radius sphere with center line of effect at resolution. No numerical cap, secret allegiance detection or post-roll omission. Each makes INT. NEW success takes half the shared4d6psychic and no denial; failure takes full damage and independently attempts one finite Reaction-debt record. The debt denies the next otherwise legal Reaction the target actually elects to take before the END of its next future regular turn, excluding an already-underway turn. At that declaration first verify ordinary trigger/source/capacity; if legal, consume one Reaction entitlement of the chosen kind and the debt, then do not execute the chosen reaction or charge its further RP/item/technique cost. It is lost, not replaced by another kind of Reaction. Invalid proposals do not consume the debt. A target that already spent its present Reaction can still lose its next refreshed legal one inside the deadline; a target with no remaining opportunity loses nothing when debt expires. The triggering Reaction, if any, has finished before this spell and is unaffected. Only one unspent Mental Bomb debt per target across all casters: keep the earliest still-live record and original deadline; another failed save can deal its own damage but cannot stack, extend or refresh that debt. An independently granted special Reaction is eligible when it is the next legal chosen Reaction; no additional Reaction is invented. Suppression lets declarations during suppression proceed normally without consuming the dormant debt, while its fixed clock continues. No concentration, hard whole-Action guard claim, permanent Reaction loss, stored payment, attack critical or object damage. Actual damage defenses and denial defenses are separate.

conferenceDecisions.question: Agree the restored20ft all-creature sphere, WIS/30ft fixed-center movement and explicit finite original marker/no-phase completion?
conferenceDecisions.proposal:
Action; perceived center within60feet and caster line of effect; V/S/F; KEEP5d6psychic and compelled movement away. NEW one instantaneous pulse in a20-foot-radius sphere with center line of effect, affecting all creatures including allies, no sight/hearing gate or actual insects. Snapshot recipients at resolution. Each makes WIS; success takes half the shared5d6psychic and no movement instruction; failure takes full damage and separately attempts one soft compelled-movement instruction. It orders movement away from this fixed world-space center at the target's next future regular START after mandatory processing, excluding a turn already underway. Spend up to30feet of its actual available ordinary movement making as much safe legal progress away as possible; each segment must increase distance from the original center. Target/controller chooses the route and existing mode. Pay real terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, no flight/teleport grant, extra distance, Dash, compelled Action or known serious hazard/self-destructive route. A blocked or exhausted budget gives only available safe meaningful progress, possibly0, then the instruction ends without a retry or alternative endpoint. Ordinary movement can provoke actual opportunity attacks; it is not a force push. Use existing earliest-instruction priority and actual remaining budget when other compulsions conflict. No hard whole-Action allowance is consumed for this movement-only component. One pending Phantom Swarm instruction per caster/recipient; a newly established instruction replaces only that caster's prior pending one. Different owners cannot reset spent movement. Outside initiative resolve one ordinary movement opportunity within six elapsed seconds on the shared cycle; establish initiative first when combat order matters. An attached companion uses its next actual original-owner regular attached phase with the same single budget. Suppression at execution skips the opportunity without deferral. No concentration or recurring pulse; images vanish after the initial experience, and the fixed-center receipt alone governs the finite movement. Psychic immunity does not cancel a legal failed-save movement component; Frightened immunity is irrelevant because this spell imposes no Frightened. Actual broader illusion/compulsion defenses retain scope. No physical swarm, poison, difficult terrain, cover, corpse, food or harvest material exists.

NEW DIGITAL FINITE-OPPORTUNITY COMPLETION: Record the next future original target regular START, or for an attached chassis the phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun. Exclude an owner turn already underway. With no such original schedule, record application+6 elapsed seconds. Preserve that latest marker and its virtual mapping through reorder/absence; an earlier real lawful opportunity can consume the instruction once, but a later reschedule never extends it. Finish mandatory processing before the one movement check, then expire the instruction. At a marker with no actual authorized attached phase, perform expiry bookkeeping only: no movement, Action, owner command, recharge or save. No later repair, suppression ending or owner return replays it. The original fixed area center and its application plane remain the movement reference; on another plane no route is invented and the opportunity expires. This is a proposed source-scoped extension parallel to DE4, not acceptance of its pending shared rule.

conferenceDecisions.status: Explicit selected chain proposal awaiting conference
conferenceDecisions.question: Agree selected30ft secondary reach, primary-emission locality and shared full10d8 pool with no random Chain Arc behavior?
conferenceDecisions.proposal:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous 10d8 lightning to one primary and arcs to three secondary targets. NEW choose one primary perceived creature or independently legal exposed object within 60 feet and caster line of effect, then up to three distinct secondary eligible creatures/objects that the caster actually perceives. Each secondary must be within 30 feet of the primary's original position and have primary-to-secondary line of effect. A secondary need not be within 60 feet of the caster, but perception must be genuine at its actual distance. No one identity can occupy two selections, including a large body's overlapping spaces; the primary cannot receive a returning arc. Exclude hostile worn/carried gear unless an actual separate source permits targeting it. Independently targetable objects need real durability/material defenses; the spell does not invent a vulnerable HP track for a wall of force, artifact or undefined world feature.

Declare all selected identities before commitment. After the interrupt window, recheck the primary and all selected secondary predicates using the then-current positions and fix that one pre-damage snapshot. If the primary has become illegal, the spell has no anchor and gives no damage or arcs; costs remain spent. An unavailable secondary is simply omitted, with no replacement after outcomes. NEW every included creature makes an independent DEX save for full 10d8 on failure or half on success. The missing secondary quantity is expressly completed as the same full 10d8 lightning as the primary, not assumed from an external ruleset. Roll the raw 10d8 once for the whole cast; ordinary target defenses and separate recipient packets apply. Legal objects take that amount without a creature save unless their actual object profile supplies one.

The arcs are established from the legal primary at the snapshot, not purchased by damaging it. A successful primary save, lightning immunity, full prevention or death from its own packet does not cancel already established arcs. There is no attack roll or miss result in this save-based proposal. Each secondary's save, immunity or death likewise has no effect on another. Total effect-blocking cover on one arc removes only that arc at the snapshot; destroying that cover later in the event cannot restore or add it. All four identities share the one cast and raw-roll identity but keep separate damage roots and actual source-trigger scope. No recursive secondary arcs, rebound hits, new targets in conductive water, blindness, stun, ignition or ongoing electrical field are added. Up to three means a legal cast can have zero, one, two or three available secondaries without manufacturing targets or forcing harm to an unchosen ally.

NEW AC6 CURRENT INTERFACE COMPLETION FOR CONFERENCE: At the successful post-interrupt snapshot the primary must be a legal target and an operative primary application must be permitted, before it can supply this spell's secondary emissions. An actual field preventing that primary application prevents the dependent arcs; mere damage immunity/defense/prevention, save outcome or subsequent primary death does not. The real primary body at the pre-damage snapshot is the expressly authorized origin for each secondary arc for geometric/Globe predicates. This changes no dealer: the original caster remains each recipient root's dealer under Null. Recheck each secondary's actual payload defenses independently without retargeting, recursive arcs or a second target scan. This local origin/primary-application distinction is NEW and requires review against the accepted ward interfaces; it is not already granted by random Chain Arc.

priorCurrent01Procedure.target: Ordinarily identified enemy creatures in a20ft-radius sphere centered on the caster.
priorCurrent01Procedure.rider: NEW trigger: immediately after the caster resolves a positive post-defense/pre-temp damage packet whose actual source creature the caster perceives within20ft and LoE and ordinarily identifies as an enemy. historicalReconciliations.resolution: Retain earlier completed-hostile-use trigger, point-centered20ft sphere, INT save and finite next-elected-Reaction debt including actual special Reactions.
